R3A-deer-atv-0005.pressureWhy: Busier: within 1 km of a paved road (estimate).
R3A-deer-atv-0005.parkWhat: where the truck road ends (Blackwater Rd); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle)

evidence.t: Mule deer winter range u-2-005 unit J58-57-RO (official), 20 m W. Counts from October.
Cutblock harvested 2011 (15 years old), 630 m NE.
Habitat zone Coastal Western Hemlock (CWHds1): coast forest, where black tailed deer are among the most common large mammals (95%) and use logged ground often (80%) (lesson: Wet forests).
SE facing slope, 18 degrees: sun melts snow first.
Private fields 810 m S: deer feed on field edges (fields are private).

plan: Drive: from Resort Municipality of Whistler, about 74 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 99, Pemberton Portage Rd.
Park: 50.52841, -122.5044, where the truck road ends (Blackwater Rd); unload the ATV (all terrain vehicle). Map links below.
Ride: 2.9 km on King Creek FSR by ATV (all terrain vehicle) or 4x4 on rough road, estimate. Then walk 230 m SW, climb about 57 m.
Hunt: deer, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Watch the edge of the 2011 cutblock (630 m NE) at first and last light. Sit above it with the wind in your face and glass (Tip).
Use: your .308 Winchester with a 150 to 165 grain expanding bullet (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 3-33, Region 3. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-09-27, closures 2026-10-16.
R3A-deer-atv-0005.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 3-33: about 1,010 hunter days a year for mule deer and white tailed deer (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.43 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.2 km and about 57 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
